image_description: A bright green snake, identified as a green mamba, is coiled around brown tree branches. The snake has smooth, glossy scales with a uniform emerald green coloration on its dorsal side and lighter yellow-green ventral scales. Its head is narrow and elongated with dark eyes. The background includes some green leaves and a textured wall. There is blue text overlay in the top right corner.
